description: Fetch ONE article (조문) of a South Korean statute by mst (from kr_law_search) and article_no (e.g. "5" or "4-2" for 제4조의2). Never returns the whole law body. Omit article_no to get a paginated table of contents (article numbers + titles) instead. Returns the article's own text, paragraphs (항) and items (호), its own effective date (which can differ from the law's), and law-level metadata (promulgation date, effective date, ministry) kept as separate fields. BYOK: requires your own OC; pass it as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your own OC (Open API user id) from https://open.law.go.kr/LSO/main.do. The Ministry's public demo id "test" works here for smoke-testing.

article_no.description: Article number, e.g. "5", or "4-2" for a branch article (제4조의2). Omit for a table of contents.

display.description: Table-of-contents mode only: entries per page, 1-200 (default 50).

mst.description: Law version id (법령일련번호) from kr_law_search's "mst" field.

name: kr_law_article
title: Kr Law Article
